lines.en: I open my mouth and the school scatters.

lines.zh: 巨大的身体压过整片礁石。
lines.en: My huge body drags across the reef.

lines.zh: 海流被我一撞，分成两边。
lines.en: The current splits where I push through.
I swim slowly, but I do not waver.
Salmon are still moving in my belly.
My fin sweeps the whole sandy floor.
I head toward wherever the fish are.
Each beat of my tail rings through the trench.
I go around the coral to spare my teeth.
In storms I swim closer to the surface.

lines.zh: 我的阴影比我先压过去。
lines.en: My bulk comes first, then my teeth.
Half a fish still hangs from my mouth.
A wreck blocks me, so I ram it aside.

lines.zh: 海底的沙被我一层层翻起。
lines.en: I turn the seafloor over, layer by layer.

lines.zh: 我顺着雷声的方向往下沉。
lines.en: I sink toward the sound of the thunder.

lines.zh: 礁石在我身下断成两半。
lines.en: The reef splits in two beneath me.

lines.zh: 我嘴里含着一整条鳕鱼。
lines.en: There's a whole cod in my mouth.

lines.zh: 海面的雨点砸在我背上。
lines.en: Rain hammers the surface onto my back.

lines.zh: 我打了个嗝，吐出半个鱼头。
lines.en: I burp up half a fish head.
The heart in my chest beats slowly.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，让小鱼自己进来。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open and let small fish swim in.
Too full to move, I simply float.

lines.zh: 我数了数今天吃了几条。
lines.en: I count how many I ate today.
Prismarine grinds loudly in my stomach.
My eyes are shut; I am still chewing.
This heart of the sea runs a little hot.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，水都退了。
lines.en: I yawn, and the water pulls back.
Thunder makes me sleepy.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴扫开一堆鱼骨。
lines.en: My tail sweeps a heap of fish bones aside.

lines.zh: 那艘沉船里还有罐头吗？
lines.en: Are there still tins in that wreck?
I drag my tongue across my teeth.

lines.zh: 我还没吃饱，只是歇一会。
lines.en: I am not full yet. Just resting.
You are bigger than a salmon. Good.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，咽了一下口水。
lines.en: I stare at you and swallow.
The iron on you would break my teeth.

lines.zh: 你站在那，我慢慢游过去。
lines.en: You stand there; I drift closer.
The heart in my chest gives a little glow.
You are thin, but still edible.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里那根鱼竿。
lines.en: I know the fishing rod in your hand.

lines.zh: 你的影子贴在我厚皮上。
lines.en: Your shadow lies on my thick hide.
No hurry. Let me look at you first.
Well? Make your move.
You dared to bite me?
A piece of my hide is torn.
It hurts, and I am hungrier.
That did not reach my heart.
My blood stains the sea red.
You cut into my fin.
I fall back. Just a little.
Do not touch the heart in my chest.
This wound will not send me away.
Your flavor stays with me.
A whole school of salmon. All mine.

lines.zh: 你的桶里在跳，我听见了。
lines.en: Something is jumping in your bucket.
For fish I would swim a long way.
Leave me the biggest one.

lines.zh: 我饿了几十年，不差这一刻。
lines.en: I have starved for years; one moment more.

lines.zh: 你把鱼往上一提，我就跟。
lines.en: Lift the fish and I will follow.
Tropical fish are too small to taste.
My mouth is open. Your choice.
Wet scales catch the light beautifully.
Leave the fish, and I stay put.
I bump you and you drift away.

lines.zh: 你只是我嘴边的一粒沙。
lines.en: You are a grain of sand at my lips.
My hide is hard; you cannot move me.
Do not cling to me; I need my tail.
That collision scared every fish off.

lines.zh: 你听见骨头碰铁的声音了。
lines.en: Did you hear bone against iron?
I turn sideways and give you the channel.

lines.zh: 你的船板还卡在我背上。
lines.en: A plank from your boat is still on my back.
That one was my fault. Sorry.
A few more hits and you are cooked.

lines.zh: 雷雨天，同类都在海底叫。
lines.en: In storms my kind call across the seafloor.
Listen to the heart beating in my chest.
Have you swallowed a heart of the sea?
Let us circle the sunken ship twice.

lines.zh: 我不咬你，只碰碰你的鳍。
lines.en: I will not bite. I only touch your fin.

lines.zh: 这一片海够我们吃很久。
lines.en: This sea can feed us both for a long time.
Your belly is much too thin.
Together we can drive the fish into the trench.
I let out a low rumble.
Slow down. I am not usually like this.
This dead fish goes down easily.
I pick up the crate and bite it in half.
I will spit the prismarine out later.
You dropped a fish; I will eat it.
I carry the whole box in my mouth.
Things too small are not worth my time.

lines.zh: 这枚心，我已经有一颗了。
lines.en: I already have one of those hearts.
I press it into the sand and hide it.
I swallow it, then spit it back.
Do not take what is in the wreck.

lines.zh: 你游动的样子像条大鱼。
lines.en: You swim like a large fish.
I can smell the blood on you.
This sea is mine to eat today.
I come around from behind the wreck.
Your heartbeat is fast and loud.
I have chosen you. Do not run.
There is still a fish on that rod.
You would chew better than a fish.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，海水自己涌进来。
lines.en: I gape, and the sea pours into me.
I am hungry, and here you are.
I circle you and do not rush.
You are swimming up. Even better.
I herd you toward the reef.

lines.zh: 我厚实的身子挡住你的光。
lines.en: My bulk blots out your light now.

lines.zh: 别贴着海底，那里没退路。
lines.en: Not the seafloor; there is no way out.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，水就把你推回。
lines.en: One beat of my tail pushes you back.
Listen to the noise in my belly.
I wait for you to reach the wall.
Your air is nearly gone.
There. Now you are close enough.
I have you, bones and all.

lines.zh: 我的牙不是用来嚼鱼的。
lines.en: My teeth were not made for fish alone.
This bite could take half of you.
You struggle in my mouth. Good.
Iron grates my teeth, but I hold.
One shake of my head and you scatter.
Blood in the water brings the fish.
I will remember that one clearly.
I held back. You are still alive.
One more bite and it is done.
In the storm I rise from the deep.

lines.zh: 海沟里最大的影子动了。
lines.en: The largest shadow in the trench moves.

lines.zh: 我把整片鱼群都惊散了。
lines.en: I scatter the entire school of fish.
The heart in my chest starts again.
I push the wreck aside and come out.

lines.zh: 这片海今天会少很多鱼。
lines.en: This sea will have far fewer fish today.
I open my mouth out of the dark.
The thunder above is my bell.
Something very large is swimming this way.
I am hungry once more.
Fire under water splits my hide.

lines.zh: 我落下来，海底震了一下。
lines.en: I land, and the seafloor shakes.

lines.zh: 这么大的鱼，也会没有气。
lines.en: Even a fish this large can run out of air.

lines.zh: 炸得我吐出好几条鲑鱼。
lines.en: The blast makes me cough up salmon.
Arrows are too small to fill my hide.
That spell burns inside my stomach.

lines.zh: 空着肚子，我连礁石都啃。
lines.en: Empty, I would gnaw the reef itself.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的心跳乱了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my heart skips.
Below there are no fish, no water.
